description: Probe block-0 pre-FF biases beyond their measured failure
proposal: Family: parameter tying. Current retained frontier is 1,481 parameters at 99.110000%, a +0.110000-point margin. There have been 82 prior macro-attempts and 670 prior micro-trials in this family. The most recent accepted result is attempt-0183/micro-0005 at 1,481/99.11%; the most recent failed result is attempt-0184/micro-0001, where a block-0 pre-FF scale union scored 98.04%. In this bias tensor, pair 5/8 scored 98.78% in attempt-0095 and is excluded. Hypothesis: additive centering has a different sensitivity structure from scales, and the recovered margin may support the next bias union. The helper adds one ordered bias union per official micro-trial with runner-only retention/rollback. Stop at first scored discard/error, no pair, 13 trials, or 17 minutes. This is more informative than another scale skip because the last scale candidate failed by nearly a full point.
summary: The block-0 pre-FF bias skip-path evaluated three ordered unions. Two qualified and reduced the frontier from 1,481 to 1,479 parameters; micro-0003 proposed 1,478, failed qualification, and was rolled back. Outcomes: 2 accepts, 1 scored nonqualification, 0 errors. Compute used three official migrations/verifications over about 3m10s. Stop reason: first scored discard before the 13-trial/17-minute cap.
